layout: Every background is 1280x720. The bottom 80 px (y 640-720) is hidden under the game UI bar: paint plain floor or ground there. Characters are separate PNGs standing with their feet at about y=640; keep the lower-left area (x 60-460, y 300-640) as open, uncluttered floor for Magna and Dad, and keep the floor under the listed character spots free of big props. The top 56 px are under a thin HUD bar (sky or ceiling is fine). Each hotspot object must be clearly painted inside its rectangle [x, y, w, h] so a child can tap it. Painted storybook style, warm and friendly, never scary.

level01_room.description: Magna's cosy bedroom in São Paulo on a rainy afternoon: rain streaks on a big window, warm lamp light, a bed on the left, colourful toys scattered over the rug in the middle, a low shelf with paint jars on the right. Mum stands on the right side of the room.

level12_museum.description: A tapestry museum hall: a huge old tapestry on the wall in the centre showing a ship and a bronze disc with three rings (sun, moon, star), a glass display case on the left, a photo tripod on the right, a chandelier above.

compass_sm.description: Compass with the Sun and Moon rings fitted. Single object, centred, transparent background.

compass_full.description: The complete Compass of Atlantis: bronze disc with Sun, Moon and Star rings, glowing. Single object, centred, transparent background.

ticket.description: Japanese train ticket with a little bullet-train picture. Single object, centred, transparent background.

worldmap.d: Stylised old explorer's world map, equirectangular projection covering the whole world edge to edge (longitude -180..180 maps to x 0..1280, latitude 90..-90 maps to y 0..720) so city markers line up; parchment colours, little waves and a compass rose, no text.

title.d: Title illustration: Magna and Dad in front of a glowing bronze compass with three rings, the sea and a sunken city below, a plane above. Leave the centre-top third calmer for the game title text.

ending.d: Ending: everyone at Grandma's big table in Moscow with blini and tea: Magna, Dad, Mum, Grandma, Snezhana, the Yeti (with his knitted hat), all six dogs, the friends from Yerevan and Phuket, and the soaked Baron with his crow. Warm evening, snow outside.
